blocks.text: Southeast Asian software innovator AutoCount officially partnered with Cebu Institute of Technology University (CIT-U) to integrate its computerized accounting software directly into the university’s accountancy curriculum on September 7, 2026. The signing ceremony brought together key industry leaders and academic executives, including AutoCount Philippines Country Manager Vanadium Ho and Gold Partner Christian Paro-an, alongside CIT-U leadership led by President Engr. Bernard Nicolas Villamor, Vice President for Administration John Gregory Escario, Dean Dr. Alexander Franco Delantar, Accountancy and Finance Department heads. The agreement bridges the gap between classroom theory and real-world execution, ensuring students graduate fully equipped to navigate modern financial automation […]...
